name: clawd-cartoons
description: A live cartoon under the spinner: Clawd acts out and narrates each step of the agent's work, drawn by Sonnet and run in a sandboxed scene language

enabled.title: Draw cartoons
enabled.description: Off: the normal spinner, and no model calls

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that draws the scenes (an alias such as sonnet, or a full id)

min_seconds_between_requests.title: Seconds between requests
min_seconds_between_requests.description: The shortest gap between two requests for a new panel; a request goes out after each step of the agent's work, at most this often

scene_rows.title: Scene height
scene_rows.description: Rows of cartoon under the spinner

max_reply_tokens.title: Reply token limit
max_reply_tokens.description: The most tokens one scene may take

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: How hard the model thinks about each scene
